forever_changes.text: One press roundup reports a Seal usable for tanking, deeper group healing and a fuller Retribution tree; Blizzard has not confirmed these directly.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Undead can now be Paladins.
Holy Strike returns as a baseline attack at level 6, Judgement no longer consumes Seals, Seal of Fury tanks with a 10-yard taunt on Judgement, and Consecration is baseline at 20.

Holy Strike is on a 12 second cooldown and had reached rank 5 by level 38 in the demo; Seal of Fury's absorb is worth about half the Holy damage it adds, and Judging it taunts for 4 seconds at 10 yards where every other taunt is 5.

Holy gains Improved Holy Strike, Voice of Truth, Reverence, Infusion of Light and Light's Vigil; Protection gains Improved Seal of Fury, Shield Specialization, Swift Judgement, Templar's Bulwark and Iron Creed; Retribution gains Vindication, Sacred Arbiter, Champion of the Light, Instrument of Law and Twist of Light.
Blessing of Kings and Consecration are trainable rather than talents; Illumination now refunds roughly 50% of the mana on a critical heal and Redoubt triggers on any damaging melee hit.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Dwarf Shaman was shown in a hands-on demo at BlizzCon 2026, per one outlet.
Skyborne can be Shaman only when they choose the Horde at character creation.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Dwarves can now be Shamans.

Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cast half a second faster than Classic before any talent, and Ghost Wolf's base cast is 2 seconds with Improved Ghost Wolf making it instant and usable indoors at 2 of 2.

Fire Nova is a spell rather than a totem, detonating within 10 yards of your active Fire totem on a 10 second cooldown; Totemic Projection moves your totems to a spot up to 30 yards away, and Call of the Elements drops up to four totems in one 3 second cast.

New talents include Lava Burst in Elemental, Maelstrom Weapon and Spirit Weapons in Enhancement and Water Shield in Restoration; Stormstrike now increases the Nature damage you deal rather than amplifying the next two Nature sources on the target.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Skyborne can be Mages only when they choose the Alliance at character creation.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Orcs can now be Mages.
Two new abilities appear in the demo: Frostfire Bolt, which counts as both Fire and Frost and is named by four talents, and Comprehend Scroll, seen on a Skyborne Mage.

Mage has the fewest new talents and the most changed of any class in one tally of the demo trees; Arcane Blast and Hot Streak are new and Improved Counterspell's silence is guaranteed but short at rank 1.

Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.

Banes and Curses are separate categories, so one of each can run on a target: Curse of Agony is Bane of Agony and Curse of Doom is Bane of Doom. Enslave Demon is renamed Subjugate Demon, and a new Incubus summon is named by four Demonology talents.
